title: SEBI (Custodian of Securities) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2006
text: SEBI (Custodian of Securities) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2006 Dec 18, 2006| Circulars Investment Management Department Division of Foreign Institutional Investors and Custodians Website: www.sebi.gov.in Circular No. IMD/CUST/24 /2006 December 18, 2006 To Foreign Institutional Investors and Custodians of Securities Dear Sir / Madam, Sub: SEBI (Custodian of Securities) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2006 Enclosed please find a copy of the gazette notification no. S.O.1860 (E) dated October 31, 2006 pertaining to SEBI (Custodian of Securities) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2006 for your information and necessary action. A copy of the circular is available at the web page “Foreign Institutional Investors” on our website www.sebi.gov.in . The format mentioned at 3 (iii) b (4) of SEBI (Custodian of Securities) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2006 is enclosed as annexure “A”. Yours faithfully, Sangeeta Uchil Deputy General Manager Encl.: SEBI (Custodian of Securities) (Second Amendment) Regulations 2006 Annexure “A”
